title: Duolingo and Plus launch sequence

location.extent: First frame of complete animated source

slide_intent: Show related products changing within one visual family because motion can distinguish offerings while preserving recognition.
strategic_value: The shared Duo face and signature can connect the green core app to the blue Plus identity through a short transition.
demonstration: Two phones begin on green launch screens; the right screen changes to blue with a helmeted Duo and Plus signature, then both display lesson interfaces.
practical_value: Compare which elements remain constant while a related product changes color, character treatment and label.

content_islands.name: Left phone
content_islands.spec: Keep the core green launch treatment at left before the lesson screen appears.

content_islands.name: Right phone
content_islands.spec: Animate the change from green to blue, add the helmet and Plus label, then show the lesson interface.

content_islands.name: Presentation frame
content_islands.spec: Keep both phones stationary against the gray background throughout the 4.8-second source GIF.

reference_purposes.Expression: The source GIF changes the right phone’s background, character treatment and product signature over time.
reference_purposes.Application: The side-by-side sequence applies the core and Plus identities to app launch screens.
